note: Markers for the daily incremental CVE run. See cves/README.md "Daily incremental procedure".

cvelistV5.incremental: download https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/releases latest *_delta_CVEs_at_*.zip or the daily cumulative delta since max_dateUpdated; re-run tools/intel-pipeline/cve_build.py

ghsa.incremental: GitHub REST GET /advisories?type=reviewed&sort=updated&direction=desc until modified <= max_modified

osv_non_ghsa.source: https://osv-vulnerabilities.storage.googleapis.com/<eco>/all.zip; skipped: GHSA dups, MAL- malicious-package records, GIT and Linux ecosystems (covered by cvelist/kernel CNA)
osv_non_ghsa.incremental: per ecosystem modified_id.csv at https://osv-vulnerabilities.storage.googleapis.com/<eco>/modified_id.csv, entries newer than max_modified

exploitdb.incremental: git -C /workspace/raw/edb pull; diff files_exploits.csv for new ids

zdi.cursor: fetch https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/<ZDI-ID>/ for every id in data/zdi/*.jsonl whose "text" is null (status "page not yet fetched"); raw pages cached in /workspace/raw/zdi/pages; then re-run tools/intel-pipeline/zdi_build.py
